title: Customer Terms of Service
description: Specifies customer rights, obligations, prohibited behaviors, ticket booking, ticket usage, and complaint handling.
markdown:
# Customer Terms of Service

## 1. Scope of Application
These Terms apply to all individuals who register, log in, and use services on the EventHub platform to search for events, book tickets, make payments, manage electronic tickets, and participate in events.

## 2. Customer Account
Customers agree to provide accurate information when registering an account and purchasing tickets, and are responsible for safeguarding their password, OTP codes, and login devices.

## 3. Ticket Booking and Payment Regulations
- Customers select the desired event, session, ticket tier, and seat position (if a seat map is available).
- Upon completing payment through accepted payment methods (PayOS, bank cards, QR bank transfers), the system will issue an electronic ticket with a QR code to the Customer's account and email.

## 4. Ticket Usage and Check-in
- Each ticket QR code is valid for check-in only once for the rightful ticket holder at the event gate.
- Customers must not copy, counterfeit, or share the ticket QR code on social media to prevent unauthorized pre-check-in.

## 5. Refunds and Event Cancellations
- In the event that an event is cancelled by the Organizer, Customers will be refunded according to the Platform Refund Policy.
- When a Customer voluntarily requests a refund, the request must comply with the specific refund conditions of that individual event.

## 6. Responsibilities and Dispute Resolution
Customers have the right to submit complaints or feedback through the Feedback feature on the system. EventHub will coordinate with the Organizer to resolve inquiries satisfactorily.

title: Organizer Terms of Service
description: Specifies rights, responsibilities, Organizer verification, event publishing, and handling event postponements or cancellations.
markdown:
# Organizer Terms of Service

## 1. Scope of Application
These Terms apply to individuals, teams, organizations, or enterprises that register an Organizer account and use EventHub to create, manage, publish, sell tickets, and operate events.

## 2. Organizer Registration and Verification
Organizers must create an account and submit a verification request prior to publishing events.

Verification information may include individual/organization name, legal representative, email, phone number, contact address, tax identification number (if applicable), legal credentials, event organization permits required by law, and receiving bank account details for event revenues.

EventHub reserves the right to request additional documentation, decline verification, or suspend Organizer privileges if information is inaccurate, incomplete, or exhibits signs of violation.

## 3. Organizer Rights
Organizers are entitled to utilize EventHub tools within the scope of their subscribed service plan, including creating events, managing tickets, managing orders, managing Staff, check-in, broadcasting notifications, viewing operational reports, and accessing AI Reports if supported by the plan.

## 4. Organizer Responsibilities
Organizers bear sole and full responsibility for all events published and operated by them on EventHub.

Organizers must ensure accurate event information, transparent ticket pricing, clear ticket benefits, necessary licensing as required by law, non-infringement of intellectual property, avoidance of fraudulent events, and non-use of Customer data outside the scope of serving the event.

## 5. Event Publishing
An event is only made publicly accessible once the Organizer has successfully verified their account, subscribed to and paid for an appropriate service plan, met review criteria, and provided complete ticket details.

If plan payment has not been completed, the event will remain in draft or pending status and will not be displayed publicly.

## 6. Postponement, Cancellation, or Modification
When an event is postponed, cancelled, or materially changed, the Organizer must promptly notify EventHub and Customers at the earliest possible time.

The Organizer must announce clear resolution plans, such as maintaining ticket validity for the rescheduled date, issuing full or partial refunds, exchanging for another event upon Customer consent, or providing alternative support.

The Organizer assumes full financial and legal responsibility for refunds, compensations, and dispute resolution arising from the event they organize.

EventHub does not hold ticket revenues on behalf of Organizers and has no obligation to issue refunds on behalf of Organizers.

## 7. Handling of Violations
EventHub reserves the right to hide events, decline publishing, lock features, suspend Organizer accounts, or terminate service access if the Organizer violates terms, platform policies, or legal regulations.

title: Staff Terms of Service
description: Specifies scope of authority, duties, and operational audit logs for Staff during events.
markdown:
# Staff Terms of Service

## 1. Scope of Application
These Terms apply to users assigned by an Organizer as Staff for one or more events on EventHub.

Staff may only access and operate the system within the scope of assigned events, duties, and authority granted by the Organizer.

## 2. Staff Account
Staff are responsible for safeguarding their account credentials, passwords, OTP codes, and login devices. Staff must not share accounts with others or use another person's account to perform system operations.

## 3. Staff Rights
Depending on permissions, Staff may view assigned event lists, check tasks, update task statuses, scan QR/NFC to verify tickets, check in valid tickets, search tickets for manual check-in, view check-in counts, support on-site booking, and confirm on-site cash payments if authorized.

## 4. Staff Responsibilities
Staff must perform duties according to proper procedures and assigned scope.

Staff must not check in invalid tickets, arbitrarily alter ticket statuses, disclose attendee information, duplicate attendee lists, use event data for personal gain, falsify check-in metrics, or abuse authority to assist unauthorized persons into events.

## 5. Operational Audit Log
All critical actions performed by Staff may be logged, including ticket scans, check-ins, manual check-ins, task updates, on-site payment confirmations, and relevant data changes.

This log is used for auditing, reconciliation, complaint investigation, fraud detection, and operational event safety.

## 6. Termination of Staff Privileges
The Organizer or EventHub reserves the right to revoke Staff privileges once duties are completed, if the individual is no longer part of the event, or upon violation of platform policies.

title: Personal Data Privacy Policy
description: Regulates collection, utilization, storage, sharing, and safeguarding of personal data.
markdown:
# Personal Data Privacy Policy

## 1. Consent
By registering, accessing, or using EventHub, users consent to the collection, storage, and processing of personal data in accordance with this Policy.

Users who do not agree have the right to discontinue platform use or submit requests to restrict, update, or erase personal data within supported scopes and statutory regulations.

## 2. Purpose of Data Collection
EventHub collects personal data to create and maintain accounts, authenticate logins, process bookings and payments, issue electronic tickets, facilitate check-in, manage events, send notifications, provide customer support, resolve disputes, personalize experiences, generate aggregate analytics, detect fraud, and comply with legal requirements.

## 3. Scope of Collected Information
For Customers, EventHub may collect full name, email, phone number, account information, orders, tickets, payment history, check-in records, favorite events, feedback, and technical diagnostic data.

For Organizers, EventHub may collect representative details, organization info, verification credentials, receiving bank accounts, subscription plans, event data, ticket metrics, and operational reports.

For Staff, EventHub may collect full name, email, phone number, assigned events, shifts, check-in history, and activity logs.

## 4. Information Sharing
EventHub does not sell users' personal data to third parties.

Personal data may be shared strictly as necessary with the respective Event Organizer, assigned Staff, payment gateways, banking partners, technical service providers, or competent government authorities upon lawful request.

## 5. Retention Period
Personal data is retained for the period necessary to service accounts, complete transactions, manage events, resolve disputes, maintain system security, and satisfy legal obligations.

Users may request deletion of their account or personal data. EventHub may retain certain records if required for accounting, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

## 6. User Rights
Users have the right to review, update, modify, request erasure of personal data, restrict certain processing purposes, opt out of marketing communications, and file complaints if data is misused.

## 7. Security Commitments
EventHub implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal data, including role-based access control, password hashing, secure encrypted connections (HTTPS/SSL), system logging, and administrative safeguards.

In the event of a data breach, EventHub will execute remediation procedures, evaluate impacts, and notify affected parties and authorities as required by applicable laws.

title: Payment Security Policy
description: Regulates payment data protection, webhooks, OTP, SSL, and user obligations.
markdown:
# Payment Security Policy

## 1. Security Commitment
EventHub is committed to safeguarding users' payment details during ticket bookings, service plan subscriptions, and paid service transactions.

Online transactions are processed via licensed payment gateways, banking partners, or authorized intermediaries. EventHub does not directly process or store sensitive payment card credentials.

## 2. Information Stored by EventHub
EventHub stores only transaction management records, such as order codes, transaction IDs, payment methods, payment status, amount, timestamp, gateway reference codes, and bank or channel names.

EventHub never stores full card numbers, CVV/CVC codes, online banking passwords, OTP codes, or sensitive payment authentication secrets.

## 3. Protective Measures
EventHub employs HTTPS/SSL encryption, gateway transaction verification, webhook signature verification, role-based transaction access control, and comprehensive audit logs. EventHub never requests banking passwords, OTPs, or card security codes through unofficial channels.

## 4. User Responsibilities
Users must conduct payments exclusively through official EventHub interfaces or authorized redirected gateway portals.

Users must never disclose card details, banking passwords, OTPs, or authentication secrets to any individual or unofficial party.

## 5. Handling Payment Anomalies
If funds are deducted but an order is not marked successful, EventHub will verify the transaction status with the payment gateway.

If the transaction is verified as successful, EventHub will update the status and issue tickets or activate the subscription. If the transaction failed but funds were held by the bank, refund processing follows the banking partner's standard clearing protocols.

title: Payment Policy
description: Specifies payment methods, transaction confirmation, expired orders, and payment issues.
markdown:
# Payment Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs payment transactions on EventHub, including ticket purchases by Customers and service plan subscriptions by Organizers.

## 2. Payment Methods
EventHub supports bank transfer, integrated payment gateway checkouts, VietQR, electronic wallets, domestic and international cards, and on-site payments where permitted.

Available methods are explicitly shown on the checkout screen prior to final confirmation.

## 3. Transaction Confirmation
A transaction is considered successful only when EventHub receives valid confirmation from the payment gateway or integrated banking provider.

For ticket purchases, tickets are issued only after payment succeeds. For Organizer subscription plans, plan benefits are activated immediately upon verified payment.

## 4. Order Expiration
Orders not completed within the allotted reservation window will expire automatically. Reserved seats and ticket inventory will be released back to public availability.

## 5. Payment Anomalies
If funds are debited from the user's account but the order does not update, EventHub will reconcile the transaction with the payment gateway.

Upon verified gateway confirmation, EventHub will update order status and deliver the corresponding tickets or services.

## 6. User Responsibility
Users are responsible for verifying order items, quantities, ticket types, total amounts, and payment methods before completing payment.

EventHub is not liable for errors resulting from incorrect recipient details entered by users, payments conducted outside platform channels, or transfers to unauthorized accounts.

title: Refund Policy
description: Regulates eligible refund conditions, non-refundable scenarios, and financial obligations.
markdown:
# Refund Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy applies to refund requests regarding event tickets, payment errors, and Organizer subscription plans on EventHub.

## 2. General Principles
Confirmed ticket purchases cannot be cancelled, exchanged, or refunded arbitrarily for personal reasons, unless the specific event refund policy or Organizer decision specifies otherwise.

EventHub provides ticketing and event operation technology; EventHub is not the event host and does not retain Organizer ticket revenues.

## 3. Eligible Refund Scenarios
Customers may request refunds if the event is cancelled, postponed without Customer ability to attend the new date under Organizer policy, materially altered, if duplicate debits occurred due to technical errors, or if the Organizer has designated a self-service refund policy.

## 4. Non-Refundable Scenarios
Refund requests may be declined if Customers miss the event due to personal reasons, arrive late, fail entry requirements, possess already-checked-in tickets, acquired tickets from unofficial channels, hold counterfeit passes, submit requests after deadlines, or if the event has a strict no-refund policy.

## 5. Refund Liability
For technical anomalies originating from EventHub systems or payment gateways, EventHub will coordinate with partners to resolve.

For postponements, cancellations, or failures to deliver the event as promised, the Organizer bears full financial liability for refunding Customers.

## 6. Processing Timeframes
Processing times depend on request complexity, Organizer approvals, and banking clearing schedules.

EventHub does not guarantee refund timeframes for cases under the direct financial liability of the Organizer.

title: Event Policy
description: Regulates creation, editing, moderation, publishing, postponement, cancellation, and compliance.
markdown:
# Event Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy regulates the creation, modification, moderation, publishing, operation, postponement, cancellation, and violation handling for events on EventHub.

## 2. Event Creation Prerequisites
Organizers may create events after registering an account. Events may remain in draft status prior to public publishing.

To publish publicly, the Organizer must complete account verification, subscribe to a suitable plan, and satisfy EventHub moderation standards.

## 3. Mandatory Information
Event listings must feature accurate title, description, start and end times, venue address or virtual link, category, banners, ticket types, applicable policies, and organizer contact info.

## 4. Event Moderation
EventHub reserves the right to review events before and after publishing.

Events may be required to revise, refused publishing, hidden, or removed if information is deficient, infringes laws, violates intellectual property, appears deceptive, lacks necessary licenses, or receives serious public complaints.

## 5. Event Modifications
For material modifications (date, location, headliners, ticket benefits, refund rules), Organizers must notify Customers promptly and resolve resulting inquiries.

## 6. Postponement or Cancellation
When postponing or cancelling an event, Organizers must update the event status on EventHub and broadcast notifications to ticket holders.

Organizers must publish clear resolution plans, such as ticket rollover, partial or full refunds, or exchange options.

EventHub assists with notifications, ticket status updates, and transaction reports, but does not assume financial obligations on behalf of the Organizer.

title: Ticket Policy
description: Regulates creation, sales, issuance, usage, verification, and handling of electronic tickets.
markdown:
# Ticket Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs the creation, sale, issuance, utilization, verification, and management of electronic tickets on EventHub.

## 2. Ticket Tiers
Organizers may configure various ticket types: free, paid, standard, VIP, zone-based, seat-assigned, session-specific, or on-site tickets.

Each ticket tier must transparently state name, price, quantity, benefits, sale period, and usage terms.

## 3. Temporary Ticket Holds
When a Customer begins checkout, the system temporarily holds the selected tickets or seats for a designated period.

If payment succeeds within this window, tickets are issued. If time expires without payment, items return to available inventory.

## 4. Ticket Issuance
Following successful payment, electronic tickets are issued with unique ticket codes, QR codes, NFC tags (where applicable), event metadata, ticket tier, session time, venue, seat assignments, and status.

## 5. Ticket Usage
Tickets are valid only when acquired directly via EventHub or official Organizer sales channels.

Customers are responsible for keeping ticket codes and QR codes confidential. If a ticket is checked in beforehand due to voluntary sharing, support may be declined.

## 6. Invalid Tickets
A ticket is deemed invalid if not found in the system, associated with a different event, unpaid, cancelled, refunded, already checked in, modified, duplicated, counterfeit, or obtained from unauthorized third parties.

## 7. Ticket Transfer
By default, tickets may not be resold, transferred, or commercially exploited without explicit consent from the Organizer or EventHub.

Where name change or official transfer features are enabled, transfers must be executed strictly through official platform workflows.

title: Check-in & Anti-fraud Policy
description: Specifies ticket verification, QR/NFC check-in, manual check-in, and operational logs.
markdown:
# Check-in & Anti-fraud Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs ticket verification and check-in operations at event venues via the EventHub platform.

## 2. Check-in Methods
EventHub supports QR code scanning via mobile camera or scanner, NFC scanning on compatible devices, manual ticket code search, order verification, and offline-resilient sync.

## 3. Check-in Principles
Each ticket QR/NFC code permits a single valid check-in entry. Once checked in, the system updates status immediately to prevent duplicate admissions.

Staff must verify attendee identity against order details when required by the event organizer.

## 4. Anti-Fraud Measures
The system detects duplicate scans, identifies already-used tickets, alerts invalid codes, and flags cancelled passes.

In case of counterfeit tickets or unauthorized entry attempts, Staff may deny admission and report to the Organizer.

## 5. Check-in Audit Logging
All check-in actions record timestamp, staff account, scanning method, device info, and gate location to ensure transparent reconciliation and dispute resolution.

title: Organizer Subscription Policy
description: Regulates subscription, usage, upgrading, downgrading, renewal, and termination of Organizer plans.
markdown:
# Organizer Subscription Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs the subscription, utilization, upgrade, downgrade, renewal, and termination of Organizer service plans on EventHub.

## 2. Subscription Model
EventHub operates on an Organizer Subscription Plan model.

Organizers select an appropriate plan (such as Starter, Professional, or Enterprise) to access advanced event creation, ticketing, marketing, and analytical tools.

## 3. Plan Activation and Payment
Subscription plans are activated immediately upon verified payment. Subscriptions are billed on a recurring monthly or annual basis as chosen by the Organizer.

## 4. Plan Upgrades and Downgrades
Organizers may upgrade service plans at any time to unlock higher ticket limits, priority support, or advanced AI reports.

Downgrade requests will take effect at the conclusion of the current billing cycle.

## 5. Cancellation and Non-Refundable Fees
Organizers may cancel auto-renewal at any time prior to the next billing date.

Subscription fees paid for the active billing cycle are non-refundable once platform services have been provisioned and utilized.

title: Platform Fee Policy
description: Regulates service plan fees, payment gateway processing fees, and zero ticket revenue commission principles.
markdown:
# Platform Fee Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy details fee structures associated with EventHub services for Organizers and platform users.

## 2. Fee Principles
EventHub operates primarily on fixed Organizer subscription plan fees.

EventHub does not take a percentage commission cut on Organizer ticket sales revenues, allowing Organizers to retain maximum revenue from their events.

## 3. Payment Processing Fees
Third-party payment gateways and banks may assess standard processing fees on transactions according to their published financial schedules.

Such processing fees are detailed transparently during checkout or deducted according to payment channel agreements.

## 4. Taxes and Invoicing
All subscription fees are subject to statutory value-added tax (VAT) where required by law. Official electronic invoices are issued upon request following completed transactions.

title: Complaints & Dispute Resolution Policy
description: Regulates receipt, investigation, and resolution of user complaints and platform disputes.
markdown:
# Complaints & Dispute Resolution Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs complaints, claims, and disputes arising during the use of EventHub, covering accounts, events, ticketing, payments, check-in, refunds, and service quality.

## 2. Complaint Channels
Users may submit formal feedback and dispute notices through the Feedback section on EventHub or by emailing platform customer support.

## 3. Investigation Process
EventHub logs complaints within 24–48 working hours, reviews relevant transaction and audit logs, and coordinates with Organizers or payment partners.

## 4. Resolution Standards
All complaints are handled based on objective system records, platform terms, and published event conditions.

Where disputes involve financial settlement, EventHub facilitates transparent communication between Customer and Organizer to achieve an equitable resolution.

title: AI Usage Policy
description: Specifies scope, operational bounds, and liability limits for AI FAQ Bot, AI Reports, and smart analytics.
markdown:
# AI Usage Policy

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy governs artificial intelligence features on EventHub, including the AI FAQ Assistant, AI Event Content Generator, AI Financial Summaries, and predictive analytics.

## 2. Purpose of AI Tools
EventHub utilizes AI to assist users with quick event discovery, automated answers to frequently asked questions, smart draft generation for organizers, and executive report summaries.

## 3. Content Accuracy and User Verification
AI-generated text and financial summaries are advisory in nature. Users and Organizers must review and verify all generated content prior to publishing or making operational decisions.

EventHub does not guarantee absolute accuracy for automated text suggestions and is not liable for errors resulting from unverified AI outputs.

## 4. Data Privacy in AI Operations
EventHub does not share private attendee identities or confidential financial credentials with external AI model training datasets. Data processed by AI adheres strictly to our Personal Data Privacy Policy.

title: System Policy & General Terms
description: Governs platform operations, maintenance, role permissions, backups, security, and violation enforcement.
markdown:
# System Policy & General Terms

## 1. Scope of Application
This Policy establishes core operational principles for the EventHub platform, covering maintenance, security, role permissions, audit logging, data backups, incident handling, and technological boundaries.

## 2. Platform Availability and Maintenance
EventHub endeavors to maintain 99.9% platform availability. Scheduled maintenance is conducted during low-traffic periods with prior notice whenever feasible.

## 3. Security and Anti-Tampering Standards
Users must not probe, scan, or test the vulnerability of EventHub systems, inject malicious code, overload infrastructure via denial-of-service, or bypass access control mechanisms.

## 4. Account Permissions and Auditing
Access privileges are strictly segmented across Customer, Organizer, Staff, and Admin roles. Critical administrative and financial actions are recorded in immutable system audit trails.

## 5. Intellectual Property
All platform interface designs, trademarks, logos, system code, and proprietary algorithms are exclusive property of EventHub.

## 6. Limitation of Liability
EventHub provides technological infrastructure on an 'as is' basis and is not liable for indirect damages, third-party internet outages, force majeure events, or organizer operational failures beyond our direct technological control.
